name: Precision Electronics Inc
old_description: Precision Electronics, Inc. provides MRO products and service to thousands of manufacturers throughout North America. VFDs, robot teach pendants, servo drives, touch screens, rebuilt spares…no problem! Let our team put over 30 years in the industrial electronic repair business to work for you. Most repairs are 30-65% of what it would cost you to buy new. How can we help you today?
about:
Precision Electronics, Inc. (PEI) is based in Hickory, North Carolina. The company was founded in 1994 by Chris Cerrito, who remains president. It began as an industrial electronic repair business and has grown to serve manufacturers across North America and internationally.

PEI specializes in industrial electronic repair and MRO (maintenance, repair, and operations) product supply. Its repair facility handles variable frequency drives (VFDs), robot teach pendants, servo drives, touch screens, and rebuilt spares from all major brands. The company offers free repair evaluations, rush services, load testing of all drives, and software backups for drive and control systems. It also supplies industrial controls and sourcing support. No facility size or headcount figures are disclosed.

The company serves manufacturers in industries such as paper, plastics, building products, wood products, and general industrial automation. Named customers include International Paper, Munot Plastics, Boral Building Products, Plasman Group, Cummins-Wagner Co., Atlas Machine & Supply, and Ed McGinnis Wood Products.

PEI emphasizes long-term relationships over quick sales, honoring warranties and prioritizing quality over shortcuts. It positions itself as a single source for industrial controls, supplies, and repairs, offering like-new performance at 30–65% of the cost of new equipment.
